target_quantile_note: Order-statistic percentile for the tolerance. The residual magnitude is not in this file; it is computed from run-*.json measurements.
abft_note: GEMM: normalized |sum(C) - sum_k(sum(A[:,k])*sum(B[k,:]))| with C promoted to float64. Denominator is max(|checksum|, |sum(C)|). Zero is IEEE +0, not a cutoff.
